answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy deploys multi-agent auditing where nodes stake capital to endorse peer authenticity. A secret whisper protocol lets random auditors cross-examine attestations, slashing entire stakes if topological cuts expose clustered identities. An attacker deploying swarms faces superlinear attacker cost scaling as O(n^2), because even a silent raven observer can reveal collusion, turning a localized breach into a punishing financial gale that dissolves fake clusters.
